text_block_list.text: One day, while out with T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, I wondered where those 
passionate gazes were coming from, and it 
turns out to be quite an adorable 
audience!"

Looking where T.M. Opera O was pointing, 
there was a crane game filled with 
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Separated by glass like this, you can't 
even approach the sun that is me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And as the light of the world— I shall 
send an opera of cheers from here!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So that their hopes don't crumble, and so 
you can pull off a magnificent rescue!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us raise the curtain!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
